phrases.english: 1.O He the wonders of whose mightiness will never end!
2.Bless Muhammad and his Household
3.and prevent us from deviation concerning Your mightiness!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ تَنْتَهِي مُدَّةُ مُلْكِهِ،
phrases.english: 4.O He the term of whose kingdom will never cease!
5.Bless Muhammad and his Household
6.and release our necks from Your vengeance!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لا تَفْنَى خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَتِهِ،
phrases.english: 7.O He the treasuries of whose mercy will never be exhausted!
8.Bless Muhammad and his Household
9.and appoint for us a portion of Your mercy!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَنْقَطِعُ دُونَ رُؤْيَتِهِ الابْصَارُ،
phrases.english: 10.O He whom eyes fall short of seeing!
11.Bless Muhammad and his Household
12.and bring us close to Your nearness!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَصْغُرُ عِنْدَ خَطَرِهِ الاخْطَارُ،
phrases.english: 13.O He before whose greatness all great things are small!
14.Bless Muhammad and his Household
15.and give us honour with You!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ تَظْهَرُ عِنْدَهُ بَوَاطِنُ الاخْبَارِ،
phrases.english: 16.O He to whom all hidden tidings are manifest!
17.Bless Muhammad and his Household
18.and expose us not before You!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغْنِنَا عَنْ هِبَةِ الْوَهّابِيْنَ بِهِبَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 19.O God, remove our need for the gifts of the givers through Your gift,
20.spare us the loneliness of those who break off through Your joining,

phrases.arabic: حَتّى لا نَرْغَبَ إلَى أحَد مَعَ بَذْلِكَ،
phrases.english: 21.that we may beseech no one along with Your free giving,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ نَسْتَوْحِشَ مِنْ أحَد مَعَ فَضْلِكَ
phrases.english: 22.that we may feel lonely at no one's absence along with Your bounty!
23.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
24.scheme for us, not against us,
25.devise to our benefit, not to our loss,
26.give the turn to prevail to us, not to others!
27.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَقِنَا مِنْكَ، وَاحْفَظْنَا بِكَ، وَاهْدِنَا إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 28.protect us from Yourself, safeguard us through Yourself, guide us to Yourself,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُبَاعِدْنَا عَنْكَ إنّ مَنْ تَقِهِ يَسْلَمْ،
phrases.english: 29.and take us not far from Yourself! he whom You protectest stays safe,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ تَهْدِهِ يَعْلَمْ، وَمَنْ تُقَرِّبُهُ إلَيْكَ يَغْنَمْ.
phrases.english: 30.he whom You guidest knows, and he whom You bringest near Yourself takes the spoils.
31.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
32.and spare us the cutting edge of time's turning changes,

phrases.arabic: وَشَرَّ مَصَائِدِ الشّيطانِ وَمَرَارَةَ صَوْلَةِ السُّلْطَانِ.
phrases.english: 33.the evil of Satan's snares, and the bitterness of the sovereign's aggression!
34.O God, the spared are spared only through the bounty
35.of Your strength, so bless Muhammad and his Household, and spare us!

phrases.arabic: وَإنَّمَا يُعْطِي الْمُعْطُونَ مِنْ فَضْلِ جِدَتِكَ
phrases.english: 36.The givers give only through the bounty of Your wealth,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ و اعطنا
phrases.english: 37.so bless Muhammad and his Household and give to us!
38.The guided are guided only by the light of Your face,
39.so bless Muhammad and his Household and guide us!

phrases.arabic: اللّهُمَّ إنّكَ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ لَمْ يَضْرُرْهُ خِذْلانُ الْخَاذِلِينَ،
phrases.english: 40.O God, he whom You befriendest will not be injured by the abandonment of the abandoners,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ أعْطَيْتَ لَمْ يَنْقُصْهُ مَنْـعُ الْمَانِعِينَ،
phrases.english: 41.he to whom You givest will not be diminished by the withholding of the withholders,

phrases.arabic: وَمَنْ هَدَيْتَ لَمْ يُغْوِهِ إضْلاَلُ المُضِلِّيْنَ.
phrases.english: 42.he whom You guidest will not be misled by the misguidance of the misguiders.

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَامْنَعْنَا بِعِزَّكَ، مِنْ عِبَادِكَ
phrases.english: 43.So bless Muhammad and his Household, defend us from Your servants
44.through Your might, free us from need for other than You through Your support,
45.and make us travel the path of the Truth through Your right guidance!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِـهِ وَاجْعَلْ سَلاَمَةَ قُلُوبِنَا
phrases.english: 46.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household and put the soundness of our hearts

phrases.arabic: فِي ذِكْرِ عَظَمَتِكَ وَفَرَاغَ أبْدَانِنَا فِي شُكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ
phrases.english: 47.into the remembrance of Your mightiness, the idleness of our bodies into giving thanks for Your favour,
48.and the flow of our tongues into the description of Your kindness!
49.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household
50.and make us one of Your summoners who summon to You,
51.Your guiders who direct to You,
52.and Your special friends whom You hast singled out!
53.O Most Merciful of the merciful!
